Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image render the depicted forms with drawing-like contours, rather than retaining the source image’s photographic or otherwise non-drawing representation?
node.criteria: Pass if, compared with the source, the edited image visibly represents the depicted forms through drawn contours or linework characteristic of a drawing. Fail if the source’s non-drawing representation remains, or if any apparent change is only a grain or filter effect without drawing-like contours. Unknown only if the relevant contours cannot be observed.
node.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing
node.endpoint: The image’s depicted forms are represented as a drawing, with visibly drawn contours or linework.
node.necessity: The instruction explicitly requests a drawing, so a drawing-like representation is necessary; without it, the requested transformation is incomplete.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the photographic source, the edited image renders both giraffes and the surrounding landscape with visible dark, sketch-like outlines and drawn internal markings, especially along the giraffes’ necks and legs. The forms no longer retain the source’s photographic representation.

d2: The node’s criterion is already specific and its trace gives concrete evidence of chalk-like tonal treatment and texture, so do not weaken it or force a “partial” label. The mismatch is that this single required check passes with high confidence, while the aggregate is all yes and the reference is partial. Inspect the full-program rubric and decision routing: partial means some requested change progressed but fulfillment is incomplete, and this node only tests chalk surface rendering. Ensure the aggregate can represent partial when this criterion passes but other requested aspects remain unmet or unverified; do not make this node fail merely to match the aggregate label. The trace’s claim of chalk-like rendering is plausible against the photographic source, but verify whether the image supports the stated breadth of evidence across figures and background. Keep visual uncertainty distinct from transport/schema failures; none are reported here.
